title: Ear training
summary: Music to listen to: an interval, a melody and a rhythm among staves, chords to sort
content:
## Listen first

A question with `play` has a speaker button. Tap it to hear the notes, as often as you like.

## Then read it

Once you answer, the notes you heard appear on a staff.

quiz.explanation: From C up to G is five letter names, C D E F G: a perfect 5th.
It steps up from C to D to E, then drops back to C.

sorts.title: Major or minor?
sorts.why: A major chord has a major 3rd at the bottom, a minor chord a minor 3rd.
